content.title: About
content.content: SoBe Energize Energy Juice Drink is a non‑alcoholic energy beverage based on fruit juices, containing caffeine, taurine, B‑vitamins and natural extracts. It is designed to boost energy and focus while delivering a refreshing fruity taste.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: SoBe is a brand launched in the early 2000s in the United States, known for its vibrant flavor lines.
Energize combines caffeine (≈80 mg per 250 ml) with taurine, a typical combo for energy drinks.
The formula includes vitamins B3, B6 and B12, which support energy metabolism.
Available in several fruit flavors, such as berry mix and tropical mango.
Packaged in aluminum cans, which are recyclable and preserve product freshness.

items.title: Increased alertness
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, improving attention and reducing perceived fatigue.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: B‑vitamins help convert food into usable energy, supporting normal metabolic function.

items.title: Antioxidant effect
items.content: Fruit extracts and vitamin C help combat free radicals.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The drink is about 85 % water and contains electrolytes, aiding fluid balance.

items.title: Mood enhancement
items.content: The caffeine‑taurine blend can promote a better mood and motivation.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: People sensitive to caffeine may experience jitteriness, rapid heartbeat, or sleep disturbances.

items.title: Not for children or pregnant women
items.content: Due to caffeine and taurine, the drink is not recommended for children, adolescents, pregnant or nursing women.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Caffeine can amplify the effects of certain stimulants and cardiovascular drugs.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Some variants contain added sugar, which may be undesirable for diabetics or those watching weight.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: Flavorings and preservatives may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Drink
content.content: Consume one 250 ml can 30–60 minutes before physical activity or when energy drops. Do not exceed two cans per day to avoid caffeine over‑dose.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, finish the can within 24 hours.
